clue.text: It will be worth money in the future

definitions.text: It will be worth money in the future

parts.words: It will be worth money in the future
parts.note: a payment slip dated ahead cannot be cashed until that later day arrives, so only then does it hold value

explanation.definitionFit: A cheque bearing a later date has no cash value until that date, so its worth lies ahead.

clue.text: Make-up specialists in the theatre

parts.note: reads like stage cosmetics artists, but the make-up is a remodelled face and the theatre is an operating theatre

explanation.definitionFit: Cosmetic doctors remodel people's looks, and they do it in the operating room, a hospital's theatre.

clue.text: Unending massacre can result in bitter comment

indicators.note: the trimmed letters are rearranged, the result being a different word
the word massacre loses its final letter, as if it had no ending

explanation.surface: A bloody slaughter leads, as such events can, to angry remarks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unending' cuts the last E from MASSACRE, leaving MASSACR, and 'can result in' rearranges those seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Sarcasm is cutting, mocking speech: a bitter remark meant to wound.

clue.text: Pickpockets may be lucky

parts.note: thieves who lift wallets are called by a slang name, and the same word follows lucky in the name of a fairground bran-tub game

explanation.walkthrough: A lucky dip is a British fairground or party game of pulling a random prize from a tub; dips is also slang for pickpockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Dip is old slang for a thief who picks pockets, and a lucky dip is a prize-tub game.

clue.text: Late but not unwilling

parts.note: late here means dead, and not unwilling means having left a valid will

explanation.definitionFit: A person who died having made a legal will is said to have died in that state, the opposite of intestate.

clue.text: Cutting short the end of the sea trip

definitions.meaning: trimming, as a dog's tail is cut short

definitions.text: the end of the sea trip
definitions.meaning: a ship's arrival at the quay as its voyage finishes

explanation.definitionFit: To dock a tail is to shorten it, and a ship comes into dock when its voyage ends.

clue.text: Warning sound not given by the careless

definitions.meaning: a blast on a car horn or a siren
people who don't care are said not to give a tiny whit, in a set idiom

explanation.definitionFit: A car horn's blast warns, and someone indifferent does not give a damn, an idiom using the same word.

clue.text: In line for a public service place?

definitions.text: In line for a public service place?

parts.words: In line for a public service place?
parts.note: standing in a row of people waiting, perhaps for a public toilet or a counter at an office

explanation.definitionFit: Waiting one's turn in a row of people is standing in line, the usual scene at a public convenience.

clue.text: Lady-in-waiting?

parts.note: not a royal attendant but a woman waiting for her baby to be born

explanation.definitionFit: A pregnant woman is awaiting her baby's arrival, punning on the courtly title of a queen's attendant.

clue.text: A rugby player, too fat to be fit

parts.note: a prop is a front-row forward in rugby
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size for the very large

explanation.surface: A rugby forward is too heavy to be in shape.
explanation.walkthrough: OS (outsize) is a British clothing label for extra-large garments.
explanation.definitionFit: Something apposite or relevant is fitting, so the French-derived word means suitable.

clue.text: Fail to win in sporting contest, short-range shot needed

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a cup is a knockout competition
to lose is to fail to win

explanation.surface: A team beaten in a tournament needs a final try from close by.
explanation.definitionFit: A photograph or film shot taken from very near the subject.

clue.text: Some turn to gin

indicators.note: turn tells us to reverse the letters of the word just given

parts.note: some, as in a portion, means part

explanation.surface: A few people take to drinking spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gin' looks like the drink, but here it is a snare.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin is a snare for catching game, the same device as a trap.

clue.text: Shanty for the rest of the sailors

definitions.text: for the rest of the sailors
definitions.meaning: a sleeping room on board ship where crew rest

explanation.definitionFit: A cabin is a small rough hut, and also a ship's compartment where sailors sleep.

clue.text: American leaves a field event with a record

indicators.note: leaves tells us the American abbreviation departs from the longer word

parts.note: the discus is a throwing event in athletics

explanation.surface: A US athlete quits a throwing event having set a best.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc is a gramophone record, a flat circular recording.

clue.text: Polite American rises to a welcome

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters are read upward, backwards

parts.note: ave is a Latin word of greeting, hail

explanation.surface: A courteous Yank stands up to greet a guest.
explanation.definitionFit: Suave means smoothly courteous and urbane in manner.

clue.text: Meals provided for the directors

definitions.meaning: as in bed and ..., food supplied regularly

explanation.definitionFit: Board is food given to a lodger, and a board is the body of directors running a firm.

clue.text: Train regularly?

parts.note: not coaching often but travelling by railway to work every day

explanation.definitionFit: To travel daily between home and work, often by rail.

clue.text: European republic the Yankees marched through

definitions.meaning: a country in the Caucasus with Tbilisi as capital
a southern US state crossed by Union troops under Sherman in the Civil War

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a Caucasus country and to the US state Sherman's Union army crossed to the sea.

clue.text: Sort out one French composer

parts.note: un is French for one
Maurice Ravel was a French composer

explanation.surface: Pick out a single French composer.
explanation.definitionFit: To untangle or resolve a problem is to sort it out.

clue.text: He leaves his country to be protected by another

definitions.text: He leaves his country to be protected by another

parts.words: He leaves his country to be protected by another
parts.note: describes someone who flees their homeland seeking asylum abroad

explanation.definitionFit: Someone fleeing persecution seeks asylum, the safety of a foreign land.

clue.text: Word book for the French team to read

parts.note: le is French for the
XI, eleven in Roman numerals, is a football or cricket side
to con is to study or pore over

explanation.surface: A dictionary for the French side to study.
explanation.definitionFit: A dictionary or vocabulary list is a book of words.

clue.text: Guarantee a Rolls-Royce is in demand

indicators.note: is in tells us the pieces sit inside another word

parts.note: want means need or demand
RR is the badge abbreviation for Rolls-Royce

explanation.surface: Assurance that a luxury car is much sought after.
explanation.definitionFit: A warrant is a written guarantee or authorisation.

clue.text: Line up on vessel for religious service

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above the next piece
in a down clue up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: a row is a line
a ship is a vessel

explanation.surface: People queue on board for a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Worship is reverent devotion, and the word is also used for a religious service.

clue.text: There's no place for him

parts.note: a horse or runner who finishes outside the first three, the placed positions

explanation.definitionFit: An unplaced competitor, one who ran but did not finish in the top positions.

clue.text: This horse shouldn't get an oral examination

definitions.text: This horse shouldn't get an oral examination

parts.words: This horse shouldn't get an oral examination
parts.note: refers to the proverb about not looking a present horse in the mouth

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb 'never look a gift horse in the mouth' warns against checking a present's teeth.

clue.text: One playing a minor part in run

definitions.meaning: a film walk-on with no lines
in cricket a run not scored off the bat, such as a bye or wide

explanation.definitionFit: A background film actor is called this, and in cricket a bye or wide counts as a run of this kind.

clue.text: Capital solo composition

indicators.note: a composition is something put together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musical solo piece of the first rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: Shoot game

definitions.meaning: a card game in which players call out on matching cards

explanation.definitionFit: A snap is a quick photo, and Snap is a children's card game.

clue.text: We take turn and turn about in the vessel

annotationWithheld.why: We take turn and turn about in the vessel (4) for EWER: no parse found; WE reversed gives EW but no clue word yields the final ER, and no blog or database gives the setter's reading
annotationWithheld.clue: We take turn and turn about in the vessel

clue.text: Such food is grown, naturally

parts.note: produce raised without artificial chemicals, by natural methods

explanation.definitionFit: Produce farmed without synthetic fertilisers or pesticides is labelled this way.

clue.text: Hawthorn cut short around the Bronte's place

indicators.note: around tells us the remaining letters are turned about into a new order
the tree name loses its final letter, as if trimmed at the end

explanation.surface: A hedge tree trimmed about the Bronte family home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' drops the final N of HAWTHORN, and 'around' rearranges HAWTHOR.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yorkshire village where the Bronte sisters lived at the parsonage.

clue.text: He can't manage his share

parts.note: an investor with a stake in a firm who takes no part in running it

explanation.definitionFit: A business investor with a stake in the firm but no role in running it.
